pNone_chapter_1: In a sun-drenched colonial-style living room in Calcutta, Byomkesh and Ajit sit in wooden chairs around a small tea table cluttered with a folded newspaper and porcelain cups. Satyabati stands nearby, leaning against a dark wood doorway with her arms crossed, engaging in the lively debate. Byomkesh, dressed in a crisp white dhoti-kurta, holds a smoldering cigarette as he gestures toward the news print, his expression focused and sharp. Soft morning light filters through slatted window shutters, casting long shadows across the floor and highlighting the steam rising from the tea.
